ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and explore the potential implications for other states.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How will the Trump administration's decision affect other states?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. I will use data analysis and public records to investigate the allegations and follow the money trail.
